$comment: Human sign-off for criteria in docs/criteria.json marked kind='manual'.
These cannot be machine-verified, so the gate refuses to pass them on reaching their
milestone until a person has looked and recorded the result here. An empty list is the
honest state until someone actually checks.
Add an entry only after genuinely performing the check:
"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "notes": "what you looked at and what you saw" }
A sign-off is scoped to the milestone it was given at. If the UI changes materially
after sign-off, delete the entry - a stale tick is worse than no tick.
